THIS MFA COMING ON FOR CONCI LIA TION BEFORE LOK ADALAT AFTER BEING REFFERED BY THE COURT, THE FOLLOWING CON CILIATION ORD ER I S PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the appellant and the learned counsel for respondent No.1 have filed a joint memo.
The joint memo is supported by affidavits of appellant and respondent No.1.
The parties to the joint memo have agreed to apportion the compensation amount equally i.e. 50% each.
Same is accepted.
The Miscellaneous First Appeal stands disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo.
The award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
Draw up the award accordingly.
Amount in deposit before this Court, if any, is ordered to be transmitted to the Tribunal forthwith.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
